name: DFW Cubing Summer 2024
information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSummer2024#42805-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSummer2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue.*** 

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
